description: Re-run the query a replay token was minted for and say whether it still returns the same data: verdict MATCHES, DOES_NOT_MATCH, or NOT_RECOMPUTED when the query can no longer be re-run. Returns the query, its hashes and the SEC accession numbers of the filings it read, not the figures. The same check needs no key at verify_url, so a reader of an agent's answer can run it themselves.

replay_token.description: Replay token returned by financials_get_as_of_snapshot or POST /v1/query/execute.

name: replay_verify
